subject: physics
content:
A bar of mass and length is lying on a horizontal frictionless surface. One end of the bar is pivoted at a point about which it is free to rotate. A small mass is moving on the same horizontal surface with speed on a path perpendicular to the bar. It hits the bar at a distance from the pivoted end and returns back on the same path with speed v. After this elastic collision, the bar rotates with an angular velocity .

Which of the following statement is correct?
